controls.label: Screw hole
controls.help: Through-hole for the screw. The default clears a #10 or M5 hold screw; adjust for your hardware and printer tolerance.

controls.label: Screw head recess
controls.help: A 90° countersink joins the screw hole to this straight recess, so the head sits below the surface.

controls.label: Bolt hole
controls.help: Centred through-hole. The default clears an M10 bolt.

controls.label: Bolt head recess
controls.help: Flat-bottom counterbore for the bolt head, with one anti-rotation screw beside it.
